text: In hindsight, I never really loved you that much.
I'm sorry, I made a horrible mistake. Can you give me another chance, Lydia?
That tradition exists because people die quickly here. Out of everyone in Skyrim, we arguably live the most dangerous lives.
You're right, it'd be too sudden.
You don't sound very enthusiastic about this.
(Character Level) You really don't think someone like me could slay a dragon? Better than the guards, at least?
(Character Level) You're a fool to doubt me. I slew that dragon with ease.
Is this going to be a problem?
Yeah, I'd like to see what the Greybeards have to say.
Of course not. I have a couple things to do first.
You finally believe that I killed that dragon?
"Do you get to the cloud district very often? Oh, what am I saying. Of course you don't."
I agree - those guards were heroes, but I slew that dragon.
You need to learn your place.
Fair enough. Some people are skeptics.
Do you support either side?
It's sad to see so many good men and women die like this, only to be forgotten.
Forget them. Farmers with swords aren't significant people for a reason.
"Nord Nonsense"? You're a Nord, for Mara's sake.
To be honest with you, I'm kind of surprised by it all myself.
I'm fine, Lydia. Remember who you're talking to.
And just like that, the "You don't deserve to be a Thane" narrative disappears.
Is this a good or bad thing?
I couldn't do this alone. I'm glad to have you here, Lydia.
A while ago, you said that I wasn't worthy of your service. I haven't forgotten.
(Flirt) So what you're saying is that we belong together?
(Flirt) I've never met anyone like you either, Lydia.
That's all well and good, but we need to find an Elder Scroll. Come on.
Fine. Let's be on our way then.
You "Don't think of me that way?" That just means you can still take it into consideration.
Actually, it wasn't made by anyone. It just kind of "is".
It certainly isn't something you come across every day.
You sound worried.
(Flirt) You do a horrible job of making me think you only regard me as a Thane.
Gods, can we do anything without you talking about honor?
I'm just as honored by this as you are, Lydia, but we have a fight to finish.
You say that like it's bad thing.
"Enticed". Mara's mercy, Lydia, is that the best you can do?
When did I say anything about love? That's not what I'm after.
Too late. I've already fallen in love.
You think I wouldn't have died keeping you safe right after we met? That's what warriors do.
Fair enough. I won't mention it again.
I finished the fight. Alduin is, as far as I can tell, dead.
It's really exhilarating, you know that?
They should fear me, not idolize me.
You gave me too much to lose back in Blackreach. I had to win that fight.
It's not over. There's still plenty of problems in Skyrim that we can fix.
Well, you're clearly concerned.
I'll be fine. I've dealt with the Daedra before.
I'm worried about this, too, but it might be the only way to stop Miraak.
He's made me his champion.
My life isn't over yet, Lydia. I'll find a way out of this.
Mora has a skewed reputation. All he seeks is knowledge. I see no problem in helping with that.
Haven't you heard of Martin Septim? He was only around 200 years ago.
Would you like to be the Steward for my homestead?
Can you help adjust my armor plates?
I'd like to turn you into a vampire.
I'm fine, Lydia. Relax, it's hardly the first time someone's tried to kill me.
...What if I don't want to bother with a wild goose chase?
His note mentioned someone named Kolgar, in Rorikstead.
I appreciate your concern, but there are things we need to do first.
Anything for you.
Since when do housecarls give orders to thanes?
You're right. I'm probably in serious danger right now.
Can you explain this? (Show note)
Why so hostile...?
If my life is at risk, I'm not just going to leave you be.
(Combat Skills) You're putting yourself in danger by not helping me, as well.
(Illusion) You will tell me who sent that assassin after me.
(Persuade) Don't worry about the reprocussions. I'll take care of them.
(200 Gold) Perhaps this will get you to talk?
Look, I just want to know who sent you to meet with that assassin.
Your cooperation is appreciated.
Was that so hard?
Coincidence? How so?
Remind me what happened to your parents.
What happened to the farm?
What did you think happened to the Red-Tundra bandits?
I suppose we should head over there, then.
Of course, Lydia. Take all the time you need.
I think it would be best if we got underway.
A mistake?
How many times have you saved my life now? I owe you this much, as a friend.
I don't think I'd be a very good lover if I didn't know these things about you, Lydia.
Maybe that isn't what I want from you, Lydia. Maybe I just want normal love.
I understand. I'm sorry I forgot how important to you this is, Lydia.
You're still human, Lydia. I can't let you keep things like this under the rug.
I'm sorry. I should've been more considerate of the way you feel.
It wasn't a mistake. It was important I learned all this about you.
I think we should leave.
Should we get underway?
There's clearly a problem here that you haven't resolved. I intend to help you with it.
It's certainly one of the bigger bandit holdouts I've seen.
It probably just winds off into the mountains. I'd rather not get lost out here.
Good call. Let's head up there and figure out what we're up against.
Looks like there are about as many as you thought. A mix of bandits and deserters.
You're the last person I'd ever expect to want to help people who fled their army...
What future conflict would we use these people in?
Those cowards aren't worth it.
You're right. Let's see if we can work something out with the deserters.
A bunch of weak-necked cowards who ran from battle don't scare me.
Our quarrel isn't with you, just Vonjar.
(Restoration) Will fighting for a bandit bring you back under Stendarr's fold?
The civil war was not Stendarr's will. Fighting steadfast among your comrades was, and you failed.
(Heavy Armor) I had no trouble fighting outside. The confined space will make it easier.
(Persuade) Vonjar isn't worth fighting for. He's a bandit - you're not.
I guess that means this ends with one of us dead.
Looks like you'll die without honor, then.
I'm here for Vonjar, not you.
(Destruction) I could easily bring this keep down around you all and escape in time.
(Two-Handed) In an open space like this, I'll have no problem cutting through you.
(Persuade) What makes Vonjar a more worthy leader than Ulfric?
Then I suppose your mother is avenged.
That's... crass. Even if he killed your mother.
I'm glad this worked out for you.
Does this really make things better?
I think we're about done here. Let's head home.
Are you familiar with a bandit named Vonjar Red-Tundra?
It seemed like he was trying to build an army of deserters from the war.
He's dead. Lydia here told me all about what the Red-Tundras used to do.
Real stroke of genius you had, wanting to tell the Jarl about this whole affair.
It's fine, Lydia. It wasn't that long of a wait.
Everything you've done means the world to me, Lydia. I want you to know that I care about you, a lot.
I'd say this is a fairly scenic view we have here. It's a shame you've got ice in your veins, though.
I'm insulted by how little faith you have in me. I don't plan on getting killed any time soon.
Exactly. I'm not easy to kill. So stop worrying about losing me.
Well, Irelith and I assembled some of the guards...
I'm sorry. I should have given your request more heed.
We could just... hope that you never need saving THAT badly.
Lydia, you're going to need to learn to take risks if you want to be happy.
I understand your concerns. I won't bring this up again.
You've been this way since we met - you served me, even when you didn't want to.
I'm really lucky to have someone like you, you know that?
Really nice view we have out here...
I'm glad you had a moral ephiphany - but I wish you got back here faster.
Gods, I wish you were still a guard so you could have been my jailer.
Are you ready to keep making stories?
It's not that big of a deal - we know how to get the horn.
We might have to make someone regret taking that horn...
I'll be fine, Lydia. You worry too much.
And here I wanted to take on their whole guard force alone and kidnap the ambassador.
Esbern seems like he knows what he's talking about.
I don't know. It seemed pretty obvious that I'd use a shout to defeat Alduin.
That was... underwhelming.
I don't intend to stop while I have momentum against him.
I promise I'll be careful.
I think we both know that I might not make it back.
I'm really glad you feel that way, Lydia. In fact, it's hard to take in.
I'm just glad you're hear to share the moment, Lydia.
Where do you want to go next? Atmora, or the Heart of Black Marsh?
...You were just going on about how beautiful this infernal scroll is.
Looks like that warm bed will have to wait.
You're still concerned about that? Have some faith in me.
You seem excited...
We've barely gotten started. Who knows what we're in for.
I figured the fact that she's a vampire would bother you.
She's right over there and can easily hear our conversation...
I'm sure everything will be fine. She seems friendly enough.
Good thing my loving, overzealous wife would never let another woman lay a finger on me.
Good point. I'll be careful.
You're not jealous, are you?
What's your verdict? Does she deserve to be Thane of Whiterun? Or is the title continually abused?
Are you still concerned about her?
Seems like that's becoming a theme in our relationship.
I was expecting you to go off on a tirade about how concerned you are about my safety...
Glad to see you've come around about her.
Do you at least trust that she'll stand by us?
I'm glad you've come around, but we have a keep to storm.
Why did you leave the Imperial Legion?
Why did you leave the Stormcloak Rebellion?
How did you meet Eselda?
How did you meet Fenrar?
Vonjar is dead. As far as I'm concerned, the canyon is yours.
Defeating Alduin really was something, wasn't it?
How many more times do I have to save the world to earn your respect?
I'd been fighting Alduin since I escaped Helgen, really.
I wish I had your help at Skuldafn, and in Sovngarde.
What was your favorite part?
Wait, you, there’s specific training on how to address a Thane?
That’s rather demanding of you.
What happens if I save the world four times over?
I think stopping Ancano and Harkon counts…
Lydia, you never stopped being rude to me.
I'm just happy you're here now.
There were a lot of warriors in Shor's Hall. I don't know if I saw her or not.
Why did the other guards discourage you from becoming a housecarl?
I appreciate you saying that.
Why do you think you had so little faith in Skyrim in the first place?
You certainly have never been what anyone would expect a housecarl to be.
"Do you get out of the cloud district very often? Oh, what am I saying, of course you don't."
Let's be on our way.
So you've come around about Serana?
However hard it might have been, I convinced her to be cured.
I certainly disagree with the comparison of you and her.
I have to respect your willingness to apologize to people...
It's never seemed like she was holding back from biting either of us.
Shut your bloody mouth.
I'm too busy thinking about you.
I care about Serana... a lot.
I have, and she doesn't share them.
I already have. It went... exceedingly well.
That was all I wanted to discuss.
No one would get close to me either way. You just rush in out of bravado.
I think it’s good for what we do, since we tend to fight a lot of opponents.
I think I've barely stratched the surface of the Arcane.
Bold of you to even consider weapons and armor a worthy comparison to magic.
I followed your example.
That’s why I use maces and axes.
Is fighting as a team that strange of a concept?
Better than rushing in head-on.
A shield. When you already have a whole sword blade and heavy armor to defend with.
Your assistance is always appreciated.
It seemed like a useful supplement for normal weapons.
Because I would have to shoot more arrows if you weren’t helping me fight?
As if I get enough “help”.
Well, you insist on “helping” me a lot more than I need it…
Lydia, you mentioned knowing some of the guards who died at the Western Watchtower...
If you really don't want to...
How is this an "interrogation"?
They sound like good people. I'm sorry I couldn't save them.
I thought you didn't want to talk about this...
Lydia, remember when we talked about the guards who fell at the Western Watchtower?
Skyrim.
Black Marsh.
Alinor.
Orsinium.
It sounds like you're trying to dodge the question.
It sounds like you're angry at me for this...
Is that why you didn't trust me at first?
What about me? We've worked together for a little while now.
So I'm guessing you're over your fear of attachments?
You've fought at least one dragon at this point, Lydia. It can't be that bad.
In that case, I admire your bravery.
I promise not to die.
Is that why you mock me at every opportunity?
That's great, but quite frankly, I'm afraid of losing you as well.
I'm proud of you.
Honestly, I kind of like that about you. It's more fun that way.
Still afraid of getting too close, aren't you?
I understand. Don't worry about it.
How have you been doing since we dealt with Vonjar?
I really don't want to think about that, Lydia.
No regrets over seeking vengence instead of burying the hatchet?
Do you think this eased the loss of your parents?
I thought you were still afraid...
I'll take the credit if you insist.
I hadn't noticed.
Yeah, Last time we shared a bedroll up here, you clung to me as tightly as you possibly could.
It's a bit strange how you talk to me like you don't even like being married, but can't keep your hands off me.
I get claustrophobic like that.
Because you're afraid of losing me.
I never said I didn't like it.
What does that have to do with the way you talk to me?
You do really make me feel safe, Lydia.
And now you're caught between wanting to be as close as you can and not wanting to be close at all.
I also lost my parents, you know...
Is it that hard for you to explain this?
Even beyond just being a housecarl, you're here for me constantly, and it means everything to me.
Being irrational is the least of your problems.
You're human, Lydia. Not everything you do will be rational. I love you all the same.
Everyone reacts to things differently. Don't get hung up over it.
If you know it doesn't make sense, why do you act that way?
...I'll get us a room.
Please calm down.
Why are you giving me that look...?
The most significant thing in my life was marrying you.
Yeah, we're *married*. I'd expect your tone to have changed by now.
Gods, I'm sorry for pushing you so much, Lydia. I wasn't thinking.
Fine. That's the end of it.
Are you seriously trying to weasel your way out of this? PLAYER MUST BE A POTATO
Can I at least close the door first?
Wait, slow down. I'm not sure I want to do this right now.
Get over here.
You're seriously willing to end it over this?
No, I intended to join them.
You took an oath to me, Lydia.
Fine, take your moral grandstanding somewhere else.
(Romanced) I was talking about a different oath.
(Persuade) How about you just go home for now and not worry about what I'm doing?
Are you going to do something about it?
I'm a member of the Brotherhood, whether you like it or not.
(Persuade) Don't do this, Lydia. Just... go home for now.
You're sworn to protect me, are you not?
I could make you a vampire too, if you want. Become one of us.
I've been a vampire before, and you didn't care then.
You're not convincing me to give up this newfound power.
(Romanced) I was talking about the other oath.
(Enthrall) Lydia, you know you're mine. There's no walking away from this.
Are you about to break the oath you took to me?
I'm not going to pass up what the most powerful Daedra could offer me.
(Romanced) Is this all it takes to break our marriage?
(Persuade) You don't need to be a part of this, but you don't have to leave.
Don't worry, I'm not going through with this.
You'd be willing to end our marriage over this?
I want to see what Mephala has to offer.
What, you going to stay here and keep having to deal with Nelkir?
It sounds like you're ready to get violent over this.
I'm not going to do Molag Bal's bidding, don't worry.
I'd like to see you try to stop me.
If I do, we can get her entire coven into one place.
Let's go to Reachcliff Cave and play along for now.
I'm going to join them.
Vaermina's offer was too good to pass up.
What, you're going to try to kill me?
(Persuade) Lydia, we've been friends a long time. You don't have to do this.
Don't worry, I won't keep going down this path.
I think you should travel with me again.
We also just killed all of Boethiah's followers...
If you're going to leave, leave.
(Persuade) And now we know where even more of Boethiah's followers are. Let's go kill them.
You know what? Never mind.
(Persuade) There has to be some way I can convince you to forgive me.
It'll be just like old times.
So you forgive me?
Want to get going?
What about, you know... us?
I am the person you fell in love with, I promise. There has to be some way I can prove that to you.
I thought about you a lot when you left, yeah.
I've moved on.
"Rude". Sounds more like you think we're already back together.
So are you willing to start this up again?
I'm sorry, but that just isn't worth it for me.
Alright. I'll find a way to get cured, if there is one.
We'll head up north and I'll get rid of the artifact, then.
You want me to just... kill all of those people?
I guess this is the end of the Thieves' Guild.
The Dark Brotherhood ends today.
I won't kill my friends for you.
So... you're ready to take me back?
You were right. The Thieves' Guild was reprehensible, I shouldn't have...
I'm not sure if killing people who trusted me was right. Especially for your trust.
I don't know if I'll ever be absolved for what I did with the Dark Brotherhood.
Those people considered me family, and I betrayed their trust...
I hope you don't take this lightly.
I just wanted to have some kind of sensual vampire love affair with you.
So... are we back together?
Being undead is overrated.
Why would I want to live forever if I didn't have you there with me?
Why do you still refer to me as "Thane" after all this time?
Really? You've always seemed kind of... casual about being a housecarl.
Lydia, we're married. You can use my name.
Why just "Thane"? Other housecarls say "My Thane".
You can just use my name.
You were hesitant because you were afraid to get close and then lose me.
You've referred to me as "Thane" while we were in bed multiple times.
I guess you can just call me whatever you want if it's like that.
So what was it?
…But I did most of the work.
What, you didn't like seeing the wonders the Dwarves left behind?
I'd say fighting two dragons at the summit of Skuldafn was tougher, but…
Alftand and Blackreach really made me see you in a different light, Lydia.
Fine, you protected me and motivated me and I'd be nothing without you.
I’d actually appreciate the “pleasantries”.
I’d imagine it’d get tiresome.
That,  or I just love to watch you blush.
If you get this dialogue option, tell Todd Howard I hate him.
If you get this dialogue option, tell Emil Pagliarulo I hate him.
You shouldn't be able to see this.
Good thing my loving, overzealous wife would never let another woman lay a finger on me.
You've told me this many, many times.
...That sounds like Skyrim.
Ah, your two favorite things. Cyrodiil, and duty.
I figured I'd take you someplace warm.
It might not live up to your expectations, but I'm sure you'll like it here.
We're barely even in Cyrodiil. Let's head down the mountains.
You really think so?
I vaguely remember you saying that you're not brave enough for politics...
We need a warrior on the Ruby Throne. There are no two ways about it.
The next Emperor is going to have to be able to fight unconventionally.
The Empire needs to return to its old traditions if it wants its old glory.
Cyrodiil needs to focus on its own problems, not the other human provinces.
What if we could return to the days of having a Dragonborn Emperor?
Being the Empress of Tamriel, of course.
Where would you want to be?
The monarch's most resolute protector.
Lydia, you're the most important person in my life. I need to do this for the Empire, and I need you to do it with me.
I'm sorry, Lydia. I know I don't exactly make your life easy.
Maybe when the Dominion is defeated.
You know what? That first thing sounds better than ruling a whole continent.
...I've always found our adventures to be quite romantic...
No, I'd impregnate you sixteen times. I want to start a dynasty.
Alright, fine. Does being the Empress of Tamriel sound better?
Thanks for everything, Lydia. I guess will cross that bridge when we get there.
You think he... frequents the Cloud District?
That's no reason to be suspicious. Most of our employers are people like him.
I'll be careful about our dealings with him.
This isn't the time for jokes. We need to get back to Lurius.
Either they're a lot braver or a lot dumber than we think.
Have you heard of this island?
I suppose that means we can start exploring the rest of the island.
You sound exhausted.
So long as I can join you.
...Where? The inn is destroyed, and there isn't much else on the island.
I think we should go back to Solitude...
